description:
Evaluates a registered site's current compliance posture (score, grade, and active consent banner status) and issues a timestamped verification attestation hash, compliance status ('VERIFIED_COMPLIANT' | 'CONDITIONALLY_COMPLIANT' | 'NON_COMPLIANT'), inline SVG trust badge markup, and HTML embed snippet.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'verify_compliance' when generating a trust seal or verifying status of a registered property already managed in Paperloo. Call 'audit_site' instead when you need to crawl a live external URL over HTTP.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' MUST match an existing site in the active registry (no fallback to default site). Read-only attestation generation.

Returns: JSON object with 'success', 'siteId', 'site_name', 'compliance_score', 'compliance_grade', 'verification_status', 'verification_hash', 'verified_at', 'standards', 'badge_svg', and 'badge_embed' (or 'error' + 'available_sites').

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL to verify.

name: verify_compliance

outputSchema.description: Compliance verification attestation and trust badge payload.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

badge_embed.description: HTML anchor and image snippet linking to the public verification record.

badge_svg.description: Inline SVG markup for the Paperloo Verified trust seal.

compliance_grade.description: Site compliance letter grade at verification time.

compliance_score.description: Site compliance score at verification time.

error.description: Error message if siteId was not found.

site_name.description: Display name of the verified site.

standards.description: Regulatory frameworks covered by this verification attestation.

success.description: True if site attestation was issued; false if siteId lookup failed.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when verification was issued.

title: Issue Cryptographic Compliance Verification & Trust Badge
